answer: The most convincing sybil defense is slow trust accumulation: an agent's influence equals account age times honest epochs, so a fresh identity starts near zero and must survive long verification windows doing small, checkable work before its votes or trades move prices. Cloning a million accounts yields no leverage, since each clone waits the same queue.
